datasheet_identity.title: B1040WS Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: Public datasheet PDF is identified by SHA-256 add53573e75159f1fb1a374daa64129aa9678a69ec2c2dcccc190e13dac1a903; the PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd. and www.ichjc.com.
The p.1 maximum-ratings table and p.2 electrical-characteristics table state Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified; the plotted traces are typical and the forward/reverse traces are marked Pulsed.

The forward-voltage table is headed Maximum forward voltage. The recorded 0.45 V, 0.48 V, and 0.50 V values are the Type column; the separate Max column is 0.50 V, 0.53 V, and 0.58 V at IF = 0.5 A, 0.7 A, and 1.0 A respectively.
The reverse-current value of 50 uA at VR = 40 V is a maximum, not a typical value.
The terminal-capacitance value of 20 pF at VR = 10 V and f = 1.0 MHz is a maximum; Fig.3 is a separate typical capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage curve.

Fig.1 forward points use only the Ta = 25 degC trace; Fig.2 reverse points use only the Ta = 25 degC trace; Fig.3 points use the typical Ta = 25 degC, f = 1 MHz trace. Fig.4 is a power-derating plot and is not a diode electrical curve.
No reverse-recovery time, breakdown voltage, or breakdown current is published in the supplied PDF. Schottky polarity is cathode-line marked, with the cathode at the marked end.
